canonical: Then he remembered the hands held out for the chains. His friend had trusted him without asking for another promise. Water dripped from a crack in the rock. Melos drank, pushed himself onto his knees, and stood. One step. Another. At the city gates, the execution bell rang. He ran toward the square. Above his friend, the sword was already raised.

canonical: メロスは、恐怖から人を殺し、話す機会も与えない支配者を責め、死刑を命じられます。妹の結婚式に出るため三日間の猶予を求め、友人を残して出発しますが、遅れて戻れば友人が代わりに死ぬことになっています。
